deadline.value: Apply by December 1 for Fall entry (Fall only).
deadline.quote: Fall: Apply by December 1, 5 p.m. EST

gre_general.value: The general GRE is not required for Fall 2027 applicants.
gre_general.quote: General test is not required for Fall 2027 applicants.

gre_subject.value: The Psychology GRE is not required.
gre_subject.quote: The Psychology GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: This PhD requires a 92 on the iBT TOEFL, above the university minimum.
toefl_min.quote: A total score of 92 on the iBT TOEFL (equivalent to 580 in the TOEFL) is required.

supervisor.value: Contact with a potential faculty mentor is strongly recommended, though not required.
supervisor.quote: Contact with a potential faculty mentor is strongly recommended.

funding.value: Admitted students receive a graduate assistantship and, if in good standing, four years of support.
funding.quote: Admitted students are provided with a graduate assistantship. | Admitted students who maintain good academic standing are provided four years of support

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline is the stated degree requirement.
entry_route.quote: Degree: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline from an accredited college or university

notes: Department application fee waivers are offered for financial need (email the department). Interview by faculty for top applicants. Catalog page also lists a 92 iBT TOEFL.
